name: vaultbeat
description: Vaultbeat: your Apple Health data, end-to-end encrypted, readable by your own AI agent.

plugins.name: vaultbeat-apple-health
plugins.description: Your AI agent reads your own Apple Health data — sleep, HRV, cycle, workouts, weight, meals, moods — from a local MCP server. The data is end-to-end encrypted and decrypted only on your machine.
